# Clemence Hoar Cummings

> Clemence Hoar Cummings (CHC) is a chartered accountancy firm in Essex offering specialist accounting, audit, tax planning, and compliance services across diverse sectors including healthcare, education, charities, and construction.

Based in Romford, Essex, CHC provides comprehensive accountancy services to personal clients, businesses, and specialist sectors. The firm combines traditional audit and accounting expertise with modern cloud-based solutions like Xero, serving clients across the UK with particular strength in regulated and non-profit sectors.

## Key Topics

- Chartered Accountants (FCA, FCCA, ACA)
- Tax Planning & Taxation
- Audit Services
- Accounting Services
- HMRC & Making Tax Digital
- VAT Compliance
- Healthcare & GP Practices
- Education & Academies
- Charities & SORP
- Construction & Property
- Pharmacy Services
- Solicitors' Accounting
- Payroll Services
- Business Structure Planning
- Cloud Accounting (Xero)

## Core Services

- [Business Services](https://chc.uk.com/services/business-services): Business accounting, audit, payroll, and tax planning services for companies
- [Personal Client Services](https://chc.uk.com/services/personal-client-services): Personal tax services including self-assessment, tax planning, and estate planning

## Specialist Sectors

- [Healthcare](https://chc.uk.com/specialist-sectors/healthcare): Healthcare accounting for GP practices, dental practices, and medical professionals
- [Education](https://chc.uk.com/specialism/education): Education sector accounting and audit services for schools and academies
- [Charities](https://chc.uk.com/specialist-sectors/charities): Specialist accounting and audit services for charities under SORP guidance
- [Property and Construction](https://chc.uk.com/specialism/property-and-construction): Property and construction accounting with CIS, SDLT, and tax planning expertise
- [Pharmacies](https://chc.uk.com/specialism/pharmacies): Pharmacy accounting, valuations, and NHS compliance services
- [Solicitors](https://chc.uk.com/services/services-for-solicitors): Accounting services for solicitors with Solicitors' Accounts Rules compliance

## Compliance & Guidance

- [Making Tax Digital](https://chc.uk.com/making-tax-digital): Guide to Making Tax Digital compliance with HMRC for income tax reporting
